campaign.viewSubtitle: Every production campaign starts here. Pick one to continue or create a new one.
campaign.emptyDescription: A campaign tracks one target molecule from cell line selection through downstream yield prediction. Start one to begin.

finish.title: Finish campaign
finish.subtitle: Record what actually happened at the bench. Measured results calibrate future predictions to your lab, and are optional.
finish.noActualsNote: Leave blank if you have not run this at the bench yet. The campaign is marked complete as predictions only and will not contribute to calibration.

wizard.title: Start a New Campaign
wizard.subtitle: Three short questions. You can edit any of this later.
wizard.step1Help: Pick the target molecule type. This drives cell line recommendations and downstream defaults.
wizard.step2Help: A short identifier you will recognize when you have many campaigns.
wizard.step2Placeholder: e.g. Anti-CD20 mAb v2, AAV9-GFP pilot
wizard.step3Heading: Where do you want to start?
wizard.step3Help: Most teams start with Cell Engineering. Pick whatever matches where you are in your process.
wizard.moduleStartCellEngDesc: Choose a host cell, design a transfection strategy. Recommended for new campaigns.
wizard.moduleStartDownstreamDesc: Already have a producing clone? Jump straight to purification design.
wizard.moduleStartCloneUpstreamDesc: Coming soon. Returns to module selection.
